Sample.evidence_source: Default NR vs Baseline: N_Tot_CI_Tmt (39) from [page/7/Text/4] + N_Tot_CI_Ctr (36) from [page/7/Text/4]. Active Choice vs Baseline: N_Tot_CI_Tmt is not reported. Default R vs Baseline: N_Tot_CI_Tmt is not reported. Strategy Method vs Baseline: N_Tot_CI_Tmt (35) from Table 3 [page/9/Table/1] + N_Tot_CI_Ctr (36) from [page/7/Text/4].
Sample.warning: Sample for 'Active Choice vs Baseline' and 'Default R vs Baseline' cannot be calculated as N_Tot_CI_Tmt is not reported for these conditions.

N_Self_CI_Tmt.evidence_source: For Default NR, Active Choice, and Default R, the paper reports 'behavior inconsistent with a preference for the fair outcome', which is defined as 'either choosing to remain ignorant of the recipient's payoffs or, conditional on revealing and being in the CI game, choosing (6,1)' ([page/7/Text/4], [page/9/Text/3]). This combined measure does not allow for the extraction of 'N_Self_CI_Tmt' (selfish choices in the conflict state) as defined. For Strategy Method, the paper states '19 (54%) chose to give the recipient the lower payoff in at least one payoff state' ([page/10/Text/2]), which is also a combined measure of 'inconsistent behavior' ([page/9/Text/3]) and not specifically selfish choices in the conflict state.
N_Self_CI_Tmt.warning: N_Self_CI_Tmt is not explicitly reported for any Tmt condition as a count of selfish choices in the conflict state, but rather as a broader 'inconsistent behavior' measure that includes remaining ignorant.

N_Self_CI_Ctr.evidence_source: [page/7/Text/4]: "9 out of 36 (35%) dictators in the Baseline condition chose (6, 1)"

N_Altr_CI_Ctr.evidence_source: Derived: 27 = 36 (N_Tot_CI_Ctr) - 9 (N_Self_CI_Ctr). N_Tot_CI_Ctr from [page/7/Text/4]: '36 dictators in the Baseline condition'. N_Self_CI_Ctr from [page/7/Text/4]: '9 out of 36 ... chose (6, 1)'.

N_Tot_CI_Tmt.evidence_source: Default NR: [page/7/Text/4]: "23 of 39 (59%)". Strategy Method: Table 3 [page/9/Table/1]: "Strategy Method N 35". N_Tot_CI_Tmt for Active Choice and Default R are not reported.
